title: 南渠記憶雨
camera: cinematic eye-level 16:9 wide shot along the South Canal
action_description: Silver droplets reveal shared memories over the canal between Sink River City and the Qingjiao mother-root as Qin Wulou absorbs the residual rain and Jiluo and Fang Zhe lower their weapons
mood: grief, exposed memory and fragile de-escalation
